description: [scene] 场景：取整份 / 摘要 / 查询节点 / 统计 / 拾取 / 体检 / 撤销重做 / 差分 / 导入导出 / 检查点 / 当前选中｜op: [read] get summary query stats pick validate diff export checkpoints selection；[write] undo redo import checkpoint restore｜必填见 params 描述，字段见 vibe3d_help {tool, op}｜import 是整场景替换，仅用于初始化或回滚

op.description: scene 下的 op；每个 op 的参数字段用 vibe3d_help {tool, op} 查

params.description: op 与必填字段：get summary query stats pick validate undo redo diff export import{doc} checkpoint checkpoints restore{checkpoint_id} selection。参数可平铺在顶层（顶层优先），省略 params 时取其顶层字段

room_id.description: 省略用默认房间；多房间/多聊天并行必传

name: vibe3d_scene
